title: 第十九章 我为宗师第二十章 本座孤独无名
slug: 废灵根修炼慢但我长生不死啊
lines: 改稻为药二十五年。
三成田地被改成了药田，百姓自然吃不饱。
崇明帝大手一挥，下令清扫欺压百姓的豪强，压榨出豪强的粮食、田地，救济百姓。
一时间，天下烽烟四起。
万州出了一个八臂天王，浩浩荡荡，裹胁十万百姓，攻打县城。
铁甲军倾巢而出，不过一月，击破叛军。
然而崇明帝苍老，群臣再次请求立储。
三月后，崇明帝言虎毒尚且不食子，宽恕废太子，复立废太子正位东宫。
大家都知道，东宫在这位陛下眼里就是玩具。
史称三立太子。
其实整个天下，在执掌军政大权的崇明帝眼里，都好似一个玩具。
按照李水生的估计，整个天下在崇明帝的折腾下，已经死了至少两成人口了。
他很少能见到小孩和老人。
药田已经生长了二十五年，其中不少珍贵药草都极为珍贵，不少人动了偷窃的心思。
天下再次乱象横生。
国师于太庙前，呼唤天雷，群臣震悚，奉为神迹。
一时间，众多百姓畏惧不已，开始仔细侍奉药田。
李水生在酒馆里听着过往的商贩说起帝京的消息，“国师真能呼唤天雷？”
开口的商贩敬畏不已，“那还能有假，那一日我就在帝京外头，忽然听到青空白日一声炸响，雷光冲天！”
“那是真神仙！”
“我们有神仙庇佑，必将风调雨顺！”
李水生则是默默盘算起来，我能扛得住天雷吗？
国师有这样的手段，为什么不早点拿出来，还搞这么大场面？
难不成是一次性的？
若是这个修行者真有这般本事，炼制完丹药之后要返回修仙界，谁敢阻拦？
到时候，还是先看看事态发展。
就在这时，忽然有一童子过来，“李大夫你果然在这里，刚刚来了一批人，正在找你呢。”
“说是什么崆峒派的少掌门，要寻你呢。”
李水生付了酒钱，开始溜达回去。
最近来天山的二流高手越来越多了，都是困在了成为一流高手的最后一步。
期望得到一枚天山雪莲子，或是得到李水生的医治，治好内伤之后冲关。
崆峒派少掌门童焕看起来四十多岁，面色苍白，这是潜力用尽的模样。
李水生伸手搭脉，对方体内三股内气混杂，“你这伤可不好治啊，照你这个练法，你活不过三年。”
content_en:
Twenty-five years of converting rice into medicine.
Thirty percent of the fields were converted into medicinal fields, and the people naturally did not have enough to eat.
With a wave of his hand, Emperor Chongming ordered that the tyrants who oppressed the people be swept away, and the tyrants' grain and fields were squeezed out to relieve the people.
For a time, war broke out all over the world.
An eight-armed heavenly king emerged from Wanzhou. He was so powerful that he threatened hundreds of thousands of people and attacked the county town.
The armored troops came out in full force, but within a month they defeated the rebels.
However, Emperor Chongming was old, and the ministers once again asked for the appointment of a heir apparent.
Three months later, Emperor Chongming said that the poisonous tiger would not eat its children, so he spared the deposed prince and restored him to the throne in the East Palace.
Everyone knows that the East Palace is just a toy in the eyes of His Majesty.
Known as the Prince of Sanli in history.
In fact, the entire world was like a toy in the eyes of Emperor Chongming, who was in charge of military and political power.
According to Li Shuisheng's estimation, at least 20% of the entire world's population has died due to Emperor Chongming's torture.
He rarely sees children or the elderly.
The medicinal fields have been growing for twenty-five years, and many of the precious medicinal herbs are extremely valuable, and many people are tempted to steal them.
The world is once again in chaos.
In front of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the Imperial Master called for thunder from the sky. The officials were shocked and regarded it as a miracle.
For a time, many people were frightened and began to serve the medicine field carefully.
Li Shuisheng was in the tavern, listening to the passing merchants talking about the news about the Imperial Capital, "Can the Imperial Master really summon thunder from the sky?"
The merchant who spoke was in awe, "How can it be false? That day, I was outside the Imperial Capital, and suddenly I heard the blue sky explode with thunder and lightning shooting into the sky!"
"That's true magic!"
"We have the blessing of the gods, and everything will go smoothly!"
Li Shuisheng silently calculated, can I withstand the thunder?
The National Preceptor has such a method, why didn't he use it earlier and create such a big scene?
Could it be a one-time thing?
If this cultivator really has such ability, who would dare to stop him from returning to the world of immortality after refining the elixir?
When the time comes, let’s wait and see how things develop.
At this moment, a boy suddenly came over and said, "Doctor Li, you are indeed here. A group of people just arrived and are looking for you."
"They say the young leader of the Kongtong sect is looking for you."
Li Shuisheng paid for the drink and started walking back.
Recently, more and more second-rate masters have come to Tianshan, and they are all stuck in the last step of becoming first-rate masters.
I hope to get a Tianshan Snow Lotus Seed, or get medical treatment from Li Shuisheng, and then clear the level after curing the internal injuries.
Tong Huan, the young leader of the Kongtong Sect, looks to be in his forties and pale, showing that his potential has been exhausted.
Li Shuisheng stretched out his hand to take a pulse, and saw that the three internal qi in the other party's body were mixed, "Your injury is not easy to cure. According to your training method, you will not survive more than three years."
